US8069128B2.description: A patent publication titled "Real-time ad-hoc spam filtering of email" describing a multi-pass ad-hoc spam message filtering approach.

Multi-Pass Ad-Hoc Spam Message Filtering.description: A filtering approach that dynamically generates a temporary classifier during a first pass based on results of a previously applied message filter that sorts messages into folders, then uses the classifier in a second pass to retrospectively inspect messages for misclassification.

Classification Model.description: A model generated during the first pass analysis of messages, configured to reside exclusively in a non-persistent memory location and purged after use.

First Message Filter.description: A message filter that previously sorts messages into a plurality of different message folders and stores first classification data in a persistent store.

Second Multi-Pass Message Filter.description: A filter configured to generate a classification model based on a first pass analysis and use it to perform a second pass on sorted messages to identify misclassified messages.

Network Device.description: A device comprising a transceiver to send and receive data over a network and a processor operative to perform multi-pass message filtering actions.

Transceiver.description: A component of the network device that sends and receives data over a network.

Processor.description: A component of the network device operative to perform actions including first and second pass analyses of messages.

Message Folders.description: A plurality of different folders into which messages are sorted by the first message filter.

Misclassification Identification.description: A generated identification of sorted messages that might be misclassified, displayed so a user can move misclassified messages to different folders.

Non-Persistent Memory Location.description: A memory-resident-only location where the generated classification model resides, not stored on disk or another persistent data store.

Persistent Store.description: A persistent data store where the first message filter stores first classification data.

Client Device.description: A user's device on which the classification model is maintained in memory and where the first and second passes may occur entirely.

Processor Readable Storage Medium.description: A medium including data and instructions whose execution on a computing device provides for managing messages.

Message.description: An email message that is received, sorted, analyzed, and scored by the message filters.

Sender Information.description: Information within messages read during the first pass, including sender address and whether the sender's address is in an address book.

Message Headers.description: Header information within messages, including a subject and an originating network address, read during the first pass.

Message Contents.description: The content of messages read during the first pass analysis.

Attachments.description: Attachments within messages read during the first pass analysis.

Address Book.description: An address book associated with a recipient that is associated with the message folders, used in generating the classification model.

Score.description: A value assigned to each message during the second pass used to identify messages sorted into an incorrect message folder.
